title: API Error: 400 while using the Claude Code in my Terminal
body: Hi there I have been facing the same error "**API Error: 400**" for the last three days. ⎿ API Error: 400 I have taken every single step to solve this issue, but nothing has worked. My Anthropic billing account is totally active and I have credits in my account to use it. The current Claude version is **0.2.49 (Claude Code)**.
author: MashoodAli-Official
